_comment: Cards that exist only for the life-gain replacement test (tests/unit/players/test_life_gain_replacement.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_archive` is Alhammarret's Archive's first line on its own. `t_turn_archive` adds an "as long as it's your turn" condition no printed doubler has, so the test can pin that the condition is actually read rather than stored. `t_opponent_archive` points the same replacement at the opponents, the half no printed card has and the only way to test `affects_player` here. `t_gain_spell` is the plain `gain_life` op; the lifelinking source is `t_lifelink_bear` from life_loss_replacement.cards.json.
